§bGT Not Hard: Singularity NEI§r

Your GT Not Hard edit: the Singularity's void outputs in NEI used to be 55 tabs (5 modes x 11 tiers). Now there is one tab per mode - Void Ore, Ingot, Gem, Dust and Fluid - and each planet is its own page, labelled "Void <Mode> Mode: <Planet> (T<n>)", in planet order.

§cRebalanced§r: Chaos, Origin and Singularity are now huge late-game towers unlocked with Alien Artifacts (space dungeon chests) and Ancient Books (dragon drops). See Chapter 1 and the Mod Guide.
